description: Cross-exchange spot price spread for BTC, ETH or SOL across Kraken, Coinbase, Gemini and OKX public order books: each venue's bid, ask and mid, the average fill for a trade size, and every buy-here/sell-there route ranked by what it nets after a taker fee on both legs (entry-tier fees by default, or your own). Transfer and withdrawal costs aren't included. Read-only: places no order. Fails (and is not charged) if fewer than two exchanges answer. Costs $0.005 USDC per call.

sizeUsd.description: Trade size in USD for the average fill, 10–1000000 (default 10000)

takerFeesBps.description: Your taker fee per venue in basis points, e.g. {"Kraken": 25, "OKX": 8}

name: spot_price_spread
title: Spot price spread
